central_bank_research.summary: 22 Sep remarks focused on discount window upgrades and quarter-end window use when repo pressures lifted, without signaling a funds-rate path.
central_bank_research.title: Fed Vice Chair Jefferson: discount window modernization supports Treasury and repo market functioning

central_bank_research.summary: 22 Sep speech said reserves look ample, overnight rates trade slightly below IORB, and reserve management purchases were cut to zero since mid-August.
central_bank_research.title: NY Fed SOMA Manager Perli: reserves ample; overnight rates near IORB; RMPs cut to zero

central_bank_research.summary: 18 Sep MPM materials confirm the uncollateralized overnight call target moves to about 1.25% from 24 Sep, with the basic loan rate at 1.5%.
central_bank_research.title: BoJ September hike implementation: ~1.25% call-rate target effective 24 September

news.headline: Fed Used Treasury Funds to Support Yen in Joint Intervention
news.summary: The Federal Reserve said US participation with Japan in intervening to support the yen in late July was a Treasury Department move, and that its own funds were not used.

news.headline: Robert Rubin Warns AI Boom Carries Risks for US Economy, Markets
news.summary: Former Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin warned that the artificial-intelligence investment boom could bring major productivity gains but also create financial and social risks.

news.headline: Mideast Oil Chiefs Warn World Needs to Share Iran-War Costs
news.summary: The heads of two of the Middle East's biggest oil producers warned that the rest of the world will need to share the burden of paying for the Iran war and infrastructure spending.

news.headline: Czech Inflation Breaches Target as Policymakers Mull More Hikes
news.summary: Czech inflation accelerated more than expected last month after the central bank warned that tighter monetary policy may be warranted.

news.headline: Ray Dalio Warns China, Japan May Pull Back From Treasuries
news.summary: Ray Dalio warned that the US Treasury market is vulnerable to a pullback of demand from China and Japan.

news.headline: Global Oil Supply Buffer Running 'Scarily Thin,' Aramco CEO Says
news.summary: The oil stockpiles that cushion the world from supply shocks have become scarily thin unless the Strait of Hormuz reopens, according to Aramco's CEO.

news.headline: Iran's Oil Minister Resigns as Exports Dry Up Under US Pressure
news.summary: Iran's oil minister resigned citing personal reasons as the Islamic Republic tries to sustain its oil industry under a tightening US blockade.

news.headline: LNG Trade Through Hormuz Extends Rebound Despite Shipping Risks
news.summary: Shipments of LNG through the Strait of Hormuz extended a rebound that began in September.

news.headline: Euro-Zone Inflation Tops Estimates to Hit Three-Year High
news.summary: Euro-area inflation quickened more than expected to the highest in three years.

news.headline: UK Firms Predict Faster Price Increases After Energy Costs Surge
news.summary: The resurgence in oil and gas prices drove up UK businesses' inflation expectations as firms planned to pass on cost increases.

news.headline: Pimco's Stracke Says AI Spending Drove Yields, Not Inflation
news.summary: Surging capital demand from hyperscalers and the AI ecosystem—not inflation expectations—is the primary force pushing real rates and bond yields higher, Pimco's Stracke said.

news.headline: China Oil Comeback Loses Steam as Iran War Drags On
news.summary: A nascent recovery in Chinese oil demand has begun to falter as the Middle East conflict and limited Iranian supply keep crude prices high.

news.headline: Man Group Says 5.5% Yields Risk Cracking AI Capex, US Consumer
news.summary: Man Group's Kristina Hooper warned that surging long-end Treasury yields threaten AI capital expenditures and US consumer resilience.

news.headline: Hungarian Central Banker Floats 2031 Euro Adoption Scenario
news.summary: Hungary could adopt the euro as early as 2031 if the government set an ambitious goal of meeting the criteria by 2029, according to Deputy Governor Zoltan Kurali.

news.headline: Google, Constellation Near Billion-Dollar Deal for Nuclear Power
news.summary: Google parent Alphabet is close to an agreement to buy nuclear energy from Constellation Energy.

news.headline: Lescure Says France Is Far From Needing ECB Help on Debt
news.summary: French Finance Minister Roland Lescure said the country is far from needing the ECB to step in even as it wrestles with soaring bond yields.

summary: Overnight risk held a constructive tone: Brent near 100.58 and WTI 89.44 kept energy premia elevated, while the S&P at 7818.93 firmed versus the prior tape and VIX slipped to 15.01. Front-end pricing eased slightly—SOFR cash 3.90 with March 2027 at 4.48—and the US 10-year backed to 5.28; USDJPY sits at 158.23 after disclosure that July yen support was Treasury-led, not Fed-funded. Supply-side oil headlines still sit against firm equities and gold at 4187. Watch energy versus the rates narrative, euro-area inflation stickiness, and whether intervention optics cap yen weakness after the Bank of Japan's 1.25 percent call-rate target took effect in late September.
